description: Spain's state retirement pension (pension de jubilacion contributiva, Regimen General) in 2026: percentage of the base reguladora earned by the years contributed (50% at 15 years; in 2026 +0.21% a month for 49 months then +0.19%; from 2027 +0.19% for 248 months then +0.18%; 100% at 36 years 6 months), base reguladora = average monthly contribution base x 300/350, capped at the 2026 maximum pension of EUR 3,359.60 a month in 14 payments; minimum pension EUR 936.20 (single, 65+). Simplified: constant base, no early-retirement cut, no delay bonus, no gaps. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spain-pension-calculator/

base.description: Average monthly contribution base in euros (base de cotizacion), e.g. 2000. Max 5101.20.

retire_year.description: Year of retirement: 2026, or 2027 or later (different scale). Default 2026.
